name: Archivio del Capitolo di San Pietro
notes: High impact ceiling because documentary records may bear directly on decisions and events; requires item-level reconnaissance.

name: Barberiniani latini
scope: large early-modern manuscript and archival collection
notes: Major corpus with rich comparison material; famous areas are saturated but the collection is large.

name: Borgiani messicani
notes: Historically important but heavily studied; useful as a control, not a presumed discovery target.

name: Borgiani persiani
notes: Small collection with possible high-value material; significance cannot be judged before specialist review.

name: Cerulli persiani
notes: Conduct item-level bibliography and script survey before assigning thematic priority.

name: Chigiani
notes: Strong potential for consequential correspondence, drafts, attribution, and network analysis.

name: Ottoboniani latini
notes: Large discovery surface; prioritize sparse descriptions, marginalia, variants, and mixed hands.

name: Reginensi latini
notes: High ceiling for textual transmission and provenance, with saturation risk around famous manuscripts.

name: Urbinati latini
notes: Potentially important variants, drafts, technical texts, and annotations; avoid assuming a subject focus.

name: Vaticani latini
notes: Largest impact and discovery surface but impossible as a first corpus without automated metadata triage.
